# Placeholder

<p class="gls-text-lead">Create a placeholder space that can be used for uploading files via drag and drop.</p>

## Usage

This component applies a specially styled area to create a placeholder space, which can be useful, for example in combination with the [Upload component](https://getuikit.com/docs/upload). Just add the `.gls-placeholder` class to a `<div>` element.

```html
<div class="gls-placeholder"></div>
```

<div class="gls-docs-example">
<div class="gls-placeholder gls-text-center">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.</div>
</div>
